name: gizza-ai/data-reshape
summary: Reshape JSON/YAML/CSV/XML with a JSONata query

tool.description: Parse a document in JSON, YAML, CSV, or XML and reshape it with a JSONata expression into a new structured result (JSON or YAML). JSONata is one language for both querying (navigate paths, filter with predicates, aggregate with $sum/$count/$max) and templating (construct new objects/arrays like '{ "total": $sum(lines.amount) }'). CSV parses to an array of row objects (numeric/boolean cells coerced); XML/YAML map to nested objects. Set input_format=auto to sniff the format. A query that matches nothing returns null. Runs locally, pure-Rust engine.

data.description: The source document to reshape (JSON, YAML, CSV, or XML).

input_format.description: Format of the input document. 'auto' sniffs it (< → XML, {/[ → JSON, a comma header → CSV, else YAML).

output_format.description: Format of the reshaped result. Default json.

pretty.description: Indent the JSON output (ignored for YAML). Default true.

query.description: The JSONata expression that queries and/or templates the data, e.g. '$sum(items.price)', 'items[price > 10].name', or '{ "total": $sum(lines.amount) }'. CSV rows arrive as an array of objects; XML/YAML map to nested objects.
